# Plugin.Maui.Printing

Print for .NET MAUI: PDF, images, text, Bluetooth thermal / ESC/POS, system / AirPrint, invoices, receipts, labels, tickets, delivery challans, and vehicle inspection reports.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Printing
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Printing
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-printing
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Printing

Registration: `UseMauiPrinting` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I print a PDF in .NET MAUI on Android and iOS?
- How do I print to a Bluetooth thermal printer from MAUI?
- ESC/POS receipt / invoice / label / ticket printing
- Delivery challan or vehicle inspection report print from MAUI
- AirPrint / Android PrintManager abstraction

## Do not use when

- The app only needs to share a file (`Share` / Plugin.Maui.SharePlus)
- The app needs a general BLE GATT manager (Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager)
